end.summary:
Practised drawing dot pictures for triangular and square numbers.
Used rows to show totals 1, 3, 6, and 10.
Explained how a sequence grows by adding a new row and column.
Used the shared-corner picture to justify 16 + 9 = 25; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised representing square and triangular numbers with dot pictures and used rows, columns, and a shared corner to explain how a square grows. They initially added the shared corner, then corrected this by explaining that it is counted twice and should be subtracted once. At home, ask them to draw a 3-by-3 or 4-by-4 square and mark the new row, new column, and shared corner when growing it.
